_note: Synthetic SOP written for this demo, styled after publicly known flood-response procedure structures. Not a copy of any specific government document.
title: Flood Response SOP v4.2
trigger_conditions: Rainfall intensity classified HIGH by weather feed
One or more wards flagged at elevated flood risk
auto_approved_actions: Deploy drainage inspection team to affected ward
Deploy general emergency response team to affected ward
Send SMS/voice alert to affected-ward responders
requires_human_approval: Deploying medical teams to a facility flagged as access-blocked
escalation_rule: If a task tagged CRITICAL remains unresolved 15+ minutes after assignment, escalate to Emergency Coordinator (on-call) and open an approval request if further spend or medical deployment is required.
